cover_headline: Labor Department Freezes PERM Green-Card Filings for Microsoft, Adobe, Six IT Firms
facts: The Labor Department said on October 8 it will not accept new or process pending PERM labor certifications for eight employers: Microsoft, Adobe, Cognizant, Infosys, Tata Consultancy Services, Wipro, HCL Technologies and Capgemini
The freeze covers the PERM step only — it does not cancel existing H-1B visas, and no fraud finding against the eight companies has been published
A suspension under the cited rule may last initially for up to 180 days, after which the National Certifying Officer may resume processing or extend it

quote.text: We will not accept any new or process any pending permanent labor certification applications involving these companies.
quote.speaker: Keith Sonderling

end.headline: Labor Department Freezes PERM Green-Card Filings for Microsoft, Adobe, Six IT Firms
end.line: The October 8 suspension halts a first step in employer-sponsored green cards for eight employers under investigation.
